n76de26ebad.headline: Global food prices up 28.1% in 2021: Food and Agriculture Organization
n76de26ebad.summary: The Food and Agriculture Organization said global food prices fell slightly in December 2021 month-on-month but were far higher across the year than in 2020, up 28.1%.
n76de26ebad.why: The FAO food price index tracks international prices for cereals, oils, dairy, meat and sugar, and is a key gauge of food inflation and agricultural commodity trends.

source.name: The Sentinel - of this Land, for its People

sources.name: The Sentinel - of this Land, for its People

n27df00bd3f.headline: Vietnam says 2021 state budget deficit was below 4% of GDP
n27df00bd3f.summary: Vietnam's state budget deficit was below 4% of gross domestic product in 2021, the government said on Thursday. The figure came despite spending to fight the coronavirus pandemic.
n27df00bd3f.why: Budget deficits as a share of GDP signal fiscal discipline and borrowing needs, which matter for sovereign bond yields and the currency. Vietnam is a major Southeast Asian manufacturing and export economy.

nf38aca741f.headline: SEC revises capital market master plan to woo investors
nf38aca741f.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission said it will launch a revised version of the 10-year Capital Market Masterplan in 2022 to reflect market dynamism.
nf38aca741f.why: The SEC is Nigeria's capital markets regulator, and its masterplan sets the policy direction for stock and bond markets.

n24a747ce3d.headline: Local stock market begins year 2022 on positive note, adds 2.7 per cent
n24a747ce3d.summary: Bulls dominated the first trading week of 2022 at the Nigerian Exchange Limited, with the local market adding 2.7%. The exchange is Nigeria's main stock market.
n24a747ce3d.why: The Nigerian Exchange is the country's principal stock market, and its index reflects the performance of listed banks, consumer and industrial companies. Moves there shape local investor sentiment.
n24a747ce3d.why_moved: Dominance of buyers ensured a strong start to the first trading week of 2022 on the Nigerian Exchange.

ne33e329fb5.headline: FG excessive borrowing from CBN threatens exchange rate, others – Report
ne33e329fb5.summary: A report says excessive Federal Government borrowing from the Central Bank of Nigeria through the Ways and Means Advances window could adversely affect the exchange rate.
ne33e329fb5.why: Central bank financing of government deficits can fuel inflation and pressure the currency, which matters for investors in Nigerian assets.

n8934abb517.headline: Shikun & Binui: Tax demand of 38 million dollars in Kenya
n8934abb517.summary: Israeli real estate company Shikun & Binui received a tax demand from Kenyan authorities for 2016-2020 but intends to appeal, citing accumulated tax losses offsetting part of the amount.
n8934abb517.why: Shikun & Binui is a major real estate developer with international operations; tax disputes in key markets like Kenya can affect its financials and investor sentiment.

nfa32d3c2a5.summary: Algeria is experiencing shortages of basic food products and general price increases due to the absence of a comprehensive economic reform strategy.
nfa32d3c2a5.why: Supply shortages and inflationary pressures affect consumer welfare and economic stability in Algeria, influencing policy and investment climate.

ned4e0833d3.headline: AHMSA pays only those who work | Zócalo Newspaper | News from Saltillo, Torreón, Piedras Negras, Monclova, Acuña
ned4e0833d3.summary: Altos Hornos de México is making payments to local suppliers but only to those continuing to work at the company’s facilities in Monclova.
ned4e0833d3.why: Payment policies affect supplier relations and local economic activity in Mexico’s steel sector, impacting supply chains and regional economies.

nb403ba0f4d.headline: PSOE still owes 19.5 million to banks: Sánchez forbids the party from incurring more debt
nb403ba0f4d.summary: Spain's PSOE party still owes 19.5 million euros to banks and has instructed its federations to avoid new debt and repay outstanding microcredits.
nb403ba0f4d.why: Political party finances affect campaign funding and political stability; debt management reflects financial discipline and regulatory compliance.

n1de9bac7ae.summary: IT companies in Slovakia express reservations about the government's lack of support for small and medium enterprises in digital transformation.
n1de9bac7ae.why: Digital transformation is critical for SME competitiveness; government support influences IT sector growth and SME productivity in Slovakia.

na5d07380d3.headline: 2022: How capital market will sustain positive momentum
na5d07380d3.summary: Operators in Nigeria's stock exchange expect capital market activity to sustain positive momentum in early 2022.
na5d07380d3.why: Continued growth in Nigeria's capital markets can attract investment and influence regional financial stability.

nefdce1d43c.headline: UP elections: Time not in BJP’s favour, mistakes will lead to defeat in polls, says Akhilesh Yadav | Lucknow News - Times of India
nefdce1d43c.summary: Akhilesh Yadav warns that mistakes could lead to electoral defeat in upcoming state polls.
nefdce1d43c.why: Election outcomes can influence regional economic policies and investor confidence in the state.

n31888ca551.headline: Crypto Scam: Pakistanis lose millions to massive fraud
n31888ca551.summary: Crypto scams in Pakistan are causing significant financial losses as online fraud exploits the popularity of digital currencies.
n31888ca551.why: Crypto scams undermine investor confidence and regulatory efforts in digital asset markets.

n13836e9fda.headline: Stocks mostly fall after US hiring disappoints
n13836e9fda.summary: US equities mostly fell after job data showed weaker-than-expected employment growth; eurozone inflation reached a new high, affecting markets.
n13836e9fda.why: Labor and inflation data influence investor sentiment and market direction.

n29764397d4.headline: Oil rides into 2022 on bullish wave as demand fears fade
n29764397d4.summary: Oil surged into 2022, surpassing $80 a barrel, as global demand shrugged off omicron and supply constraints affected producers from Canada to Russia.
n29764397d4.why: Oil is a key global commodity influencing energy markets, inflation, and economic growth; price movements impact energy companies and consumers.
n29764397d4.why_moved: Demand recovery and supply constraints pushed oil prices higher, affecting energy markets and inflation outlooks.

n0e76915ba8.headline: LP Gas Prices Rise in Coahuila | Zócalo Newspaper | News from Saltillo, Torreón, Piedras Negras, Monclova, Acuña
n0e76915ba8.summary: The Energy Regulatory Commission reported higher maximum LP gas prices in Coahuila for the week of January 2 to 8, 2022, according to Periódico Zócalo.
n0e76915ba8.why: LP gas is a widely used household and industrial fuel, and regulated maximum prices affect consumer energy costs in Mexico.

n7a6021b10b.headline: Rates and the IMF: the possible impact on one of the most popular peso investments
n7a6021b10b.summary: Some analysts warn that demand for peso bonds could shift away from the CER curve, while others highlight their appeal amid high inflation. The piece links the outlook to rates and the IMF.
n7a6021b10b.why: Argentina's peso-denominated sovereign bonds, including CER-indexed instruments that adjust for inflation, are a major local fixed-income market. Their pricing depends on inflation expectations, interest rates and IMF-related policy.

nbf3f399cd2.headline: Presidential Candidates Pledge Strict Penalties for Unfair Trading: "Illicit Gains Must Be Recovered"
nbf3f399cd2.summary: Candidates from ruling and opposition parties ahead of the March presidential election pledged stronger sanctions against insider trading and stock price manipulation.
nbf3f399cd2.why: Market-abuse enforcement shapes investor confidence in the Korean stock market, which is among Asia's largest equity markets.
